versions.subject: feat: add missing `OriginalFileName` field (#4026)
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'keymgr'
        - 'KRShowKeyMgr'
condition: all of selection_*
